name: Zhejiang Liming Intelligent Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Liming Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a producer and distributor specializing in automotive components. The company's offerings encompass a variety of high-precision vehicle parts, including valve lock clips, valve spring seats, valve bridges, and piston cooling nozzles. Established in 1997, this firm operates from its headquarters located in Zhoushan, China.
